contexts.text: Still further to the left (in the Hells of hatred) there appear great fishes, monstrous whales, which swallow a man and vomit him out again. See SE 1382.
Pharaoh is compared to whales in the seas (), because a whale = the generals of scientifics. AC 6693:4. AE 513:5.

A water-serpent () = mere fallacies and the derivative falsities... for, in the Original, serpent is here expressed by the same word as a whale, which is the largest fish of the sea; and a whale = memory-knowledge, in general. Illustrated.
As whales = scientifics which pervert the truths of faith, they also = reasonings from fallacies, whence come falsities. Illustrated.

As whales = reasonings from fallacies which pervert truths,water-serpents = the falsities themselves from the fallacies from which come reasonings, and by which are effected perversions. Illustrated... The same things are signified by dragons, but dragons = reasonings from the loves of self and of the world, thus from the cupidities of evil, which pervert not truths only, but also goods. Illustrated.

Thou hast broken the heads of the whales upon the waters, Thou hast broken the heads of leviathan (). This treats of the knowledges which destroy the truths of faith; the whales whose heads will be broken = scientifics in general; and in like manner leviathan. AE 483:16.
Chariots carved into the form of whales, etc. seen, (which were) appearances of the rational intelligence of the men of the Silver Age.
They draw in falsities as whales do water.

(Men who are worshipped as saints and as gods and goddesses) represented by great jaws as of whales, into which spiritual images were cast... and thus it was turned into a whale, or into a dragon, when it had swallowed so many that its belly could be formed. (See also SE 442.)
Similar (representations) exist also in the world... as that Jonah was swallowed by a whale, which was actually done in the world.
What is signified in the Prophet by the great crooked serpent, and Leviathan.
Like things are signified by seas, and! by the things there, which are called fishes, and whales. Illustrated... A whale = memory-knowledge in general.
(Thus) seas = the generals of truth; and whales, and fishes = the affections and thoughts of those who are in the generals of truth.

Praise Jehovah from the earth, ye whales and deeps () = the goods and truths in man from which he worships God... Whales and deeps = scientifics and Knowledges in general, or in the whole complex. AE 650:12.
A whale, which is meant by leviathan, = the natural man as to scientifics.
